micro_features: Delicate wisps of translucent rising steam curling into the air above the speckled ceramic teacup.
Finely sculpted crow's feet and expressive smiling creases radiating from the corners of the blue glass eyes.
Individual flyaway fiber strands in the ash-grey bob catching the diffused daylight from the window.
Nubby bouclé texture of the terracotta-orange knit collar contrasting with the slate blue knitted sleeve.
Distressed wood grain and chipped white-and-brown paint texture on the vertical timber window mullion.
Articulated clay fingertips with subtle sculpted cuticle and knuckle lines gently wrapping around the teacup.

negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic render, glossy plastic skin, smooth flat digital vector, photorealistic human skin, young person, harsh neon light, deformed hands, extra fingers, outer decorative border, ornate frame, picture frame
reconstruction_priority: Sculpted polymer clay facial wrinkles and warm smiling expression — AI tends to smooth the face into a glossy cartoon doll or add grotesque excessive wrinkles.
Slender elongated clay neck and delicate hand anatomy — AI often shortens the neck into a standard human proportion or deforms the miniature fingers.
Tactile contrast between coarse slate-blue knit and bouclé terracotta collar — AI tends to blend textures into generic flat cloth.
Miniature speckled ceramic cup with delicate steam wisps — AI often merges the cup into the hand or renders thick opaque smoke.
